# Contributing to KidneyCare-AI

Please refer to the comprehensive [Contribution Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) at the root of the repository for full development setup, coding standards, clinical data privacy (non-PHI) rules, testing instructions, and pull request procedures.

### Quick Start Checklist
- [ ] No Protected Health Information (PHI) or private clinical credentials in commits.
- [ ] Code formatted with `black` and `isort`.
- [ ] Tested locally with `pytest tests/`.
- [ ] Type hints verified with `mypy src/`.
- [ ] Reproducibility seed fixed (`seed=42`).
- [ ] Filled out all sections of `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`.
